007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Tool;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolAttributes;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolInput;
015
016import java.util.List;
017
018/**
019 * Updates an existing tool's input metadata with a typed {@link ToolInput}.
020 * <p>
021 * Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD},
022 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME}, and
023 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_NAME}. Optionally set
024 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_DESCRIPTION}. Use a tool whose configured
025 * function accepts the named input. The database validates compatibility.
026 * <p>
027 * This sample submits a one-entry {@code tool_inputs} array. Include all
028 * entries that must remain configured; do not assume that the database merges
029 * array entries. The update is persistent. The sample does not run the tool,
030 * create resources, or restore the previous input metadata.
031 *
032 * @see ToolInputSample
033 * @see CreateToolSample
034 * @see CreateToolWithInputsSample
035 * @see LoadToolSample
036 */
037public final class SetToolInputsSample {
038
039    private SetToolInputsSample() {
040    }
041
042    /**
043     * Updates input metadata without invoking the tool's function.
044     *
045     * @param args unused command-line arguments
046     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
047     */
048    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
049        String toolName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME");
050        ToolInput input = ToolInput.builder()
051                .name(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_NAME"))
052                .description(env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INPUT_DESCRIPTION"))
053                .build();
054        DbConnectionConfig config = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
055                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
056                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
057                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
058                .build();
059        try (SelectAIAgent client = SelectAIAgent.create(config)) {
060            Tool tool = client.tool(toolName);
061            boolean updated = tool.setAttributes(ToolAttributes.builder()
062                    .toolInputs(List.of(input))
063                    .build());
064            System.out.printf("Set inputs on tool '%s' completed: %s%n", toolName, updated);
065        }
066    }
067
068    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
069        String value = env(name);
070        if (value == null) {
071            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
072        }
073        return value;
074    }
075
076    private static String env(String name) {
077        String value = System.getenv(name);
078        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
079    }
080}
